summary.en: Slither-style snake arena — grow by eating pellets, avoid hitting other snakes, AI bots included.
summary.zh: Slither 风格贪吃蛇竞技场——吃豆子变长、别撞其他蛇，内置 AI 机器人对手。

description.en: A pure-frontend take on the slither.io formula by Bibhuti Poudyal. No server required, all bots run locally on canvas. A great starting point for reskinning your own multiplayer snake.
description.zh: Bibhuti Poudyal 出品的纯前端 slither.io 复刻。零后端，所有 AI 蛇在本地 canvas 上跑。做多人贪吃蛇二次开发的最佳起手板。

howto.en: Move the mouse to steer. Click to boost (spends length). Eat food, avoid bigger snakes.
howto.zh: 鼠标控制方向，点击加速（消耗身长）。吃食物、避开比你更大的蛇。
